# optimizelycmssaas_display_template (Resource)

A display template: editor-selectable settings (and choices) for a base type, node type or content type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "optimizelycmssaas_display_template" "article_layout" {
  key          = "ArticleLayout"
  display_name = "Article layout"
  content_type = optimizelycmssaas_content_type.article.key

  settings = {
    width = {
      display_name = "Width"
      editor       = "select"
      sort_order   = 10
      choices = {
        narrow = { display_name = "Narrow", sort_order = 10 }
        wide   = { display_name = "Wide", sort_order = 20 }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Name shown to editors.
- `key` (String) Unique key. Cannot be changed.

### Optional

- `base_type` (String) Base type this template is valid for, e.g. _component.
- `content_type` (String) Key of the content type this template is valid for.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Default template for the associated base type, node type or content type. The CMS makes the first template for a type the default regardless of this value; leave it unset to accept that.
- `node_type` (String) Node type this template is valid for.
- `settings` (Attributes Map) Settings keyed by setting key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `display_name` (String) Name of the setting shown to editors.

Optional:

- `choices` (Attributes Map) Selectable choices keyed by choice key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--choices))
- `editor` (String) Suggested editor, e.g. select.
- `sort_order` (Number) Position among siblings; lower comes first. Defaults to 0.

<a id="nestedatt--settings--choices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.choices`

Required:

- `display_name` (String) Name of the choice shown to editors.

Optional:

- `sort_order` (Number) Position among siblings; lower comes first. Defaults to 0.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import optimizelycmssaas_display_template.article_layout ArticleLayout
```
